note: Completed per-mod mappings only. Cross-mod normalization/source minimization waits for R3.

comparisons.similarities: The actual vanilla effect, constructor and target merge/tick implementation. 100-tick amplifier-0 custom arrow payload is not divided by eight.
comparisons.differences: External delivery sources only. Installed NeoForge 21.1.244 selects neoforge:poison (magic fallback) whereas raw vanilla requests minecraft:magic; this is loader behavior, not a source-mod damage channel.

components.formula: If health >1, request 1 damage; interval=max cadence(25 >> amplifier), every tick when shift result <=0.

comparisons.closest_vanilla: Entity frozenTicks + LivingEntity frost/freezing + thrown-source damage
comparisons.similarities: Literal vanilla frozen-timer and hurt factories; no custom freezing status class.
comparisons.differences: Mod sets an absolute timer of 240, instead of environmental accumulation. Snowball ignores canFreeze and hurt result for assignment; melee checks both. Native speed modifier does not itself check canFreeze, but native freeze DOT does.

components.formula: Assign 240; environmental update min(140,n+1) or max(0,n-2).
binary_parameters: canFreeze used by melee and DOT

components.formula: MOVEMENT_SPEED ADD_VALUE = -0.05 * min(frozenTicks,140)/140, while supporting legacy block is not air and frozenTicks>0.
Every 40 entity ticks when fully frozen and canFreeze: request 1 freeze damage.
Request 4 thrown damage before timer write; later Snowball callback separately requests Blaze=3/other=0.

comparisons.similarities: Uses native effect-holder admission and vanilla entity-type tags.
comparisons.differences: New tagged entity types and a redundant Thicket override; loader Applicable APPLY may override DEFAULT admission.

components.formula: Reject Poison/Regeneration via tag graph; explicit Thicket POISON false return.

comparisons.similarities: False freeze eligibility is the same native predicate used by entity tags and freeze-immune wearables.
comparisons.differences: Mod globally overrides Zombie freeze eligibility through its mixin hierarchy; Murk and Verdant use separate overrides. Gelid adds the native freeze-immune tag. Its builder immuneTo(POWDER_SNOW) flag makes EntityType.isBlockDangerous return false; this registration flag is not a general hurt immunity. No general immunity to arbitrary timer assignment or every frost speed modifier is implied.

components.implementation: ZombieMixin shim; MurkEntity.canFreeze; VerdantEntity.canFreeze; Gelid tag

comparisons.similarities: Existing native water inertia scalar multiplies velocity in the arrow tick.
comparisons.differences: 0.99F when owner instanceof MurkEntity instead of vanilla 0.6F. No new source or target status.

components.formula: velocity *= 0.99 instead of 0.6 in water for Murk owner.

comparisons.similarities: Same 140 exposure / 300 countdown pattern, in-snow countdown, cancellation outside snow, native Mob.convertTo(...,true).
comparisons.differences: Applies to Zombie hierarchy and creates Gelid instead of Stray. The mod does not persist its custom exposure/countdown fields or call the installed Skeleton conversion events. Vanilla Skeleton persists StrayConversionTime and NeoForge wraps its conversion in conversion events.

components.formula: Expose to 140, start at 300, decrement while in snow and convert at <0.

comparisons.differences: Adds external entity types; no custom formula.
